title: Combinatorial constructions and counterexamples with neural networks
summary: The deep cross-entropy method (reinforcement learning) finds constructions and counterexamples to open conjectures in extremal combinatorics and graph theory, including a Brualdi–Cao question about permanents. The counterexamples are verifiable; source checked was only the arXiv paper, with no institutional announcement.

evidence.tested: The deep cross-entropy method found explicit constructions and counterexamples, verifiable by checking, including a refutation of a Brualdi and Cao question.
evidence.unknown: Not reported in the arXiv abstract read.
